title: The Neighborhood Association Model as a Mechanism for Participatory Governance and Economic Empowerment in Urban Communities
authors: Eny Boedi Orbawati, Fadlurrahman Fadlurrahman, Ari Mukti et al.
why: An Indonesian neighbourhood-association case that links participation to local economic empowerment. A comparison point for the neighbourhood work in the CDC course.
caveat: Qualitative and single-site. The empowerment claims are the authors' reading of participant accounts.
